instruction: A clean lifestyle photograph in a medium shot captures a bright, minimalist white dance studio. In the right foreground, the young woman in a beige sports bra (R4) stands in profile facing left with her arms raised diagonally upward, her expression focused. In the left background, the young blonde girl in a beige long-sleeve crop top (R5) stands facing left with her arms raised straight up. They perform synchronized arm exercises spaced apart. Soft natural light streams from a background window, creating a bright, clean atmosphere with a shallow depth of field.
elements: R4 raises her arms diagonally upward while standing in profile
R5 raises her arms straight up while facing left
R4 and R5 perform synchronized arm exercises while spaced apart
R4 is in the right foreground and R5 is in the left background
background window with soft natural light
